summary: Steep kerb in front of apartments and houses, all within 5-6 m.
reasons: Cars park here, but residents adjacent

best_section.where: North kerb of Cunningham Street, in front of the apartment block before the junction

drivers.seclusion: Apartments 6 m from the kerb from 11 m onward; a detached house 5 m at the start; more homes across the road at 15-17 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Cars park nose to tail along this kerb, so a van fits in line.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street ending at a busier road to the east.
drivers.convention: Kerb parking is normal with several cars parked.

flags: Steep: about 10% mean grade, 13% at the steepest step
Dwellings within 10 m of the whole stretch
sun_shade: Apartment block shades the kerb in the morning and midday; open to afternoon sun from the west.
